cases.description: Return the correct identity for follower 1
cases.preconditions: Two dedicated staging Copy Trading follower accounts exist.
cases.steps:
1. Log in as this follower in a separate session.
2. Read /api/auth/me.
3. Compare account identity.
cases.test_data: Fresh follower 1 and follower 2; read-only requests; real-net.
cases.expected: Return this follower identity without the other follower identity.
cases.remarks: Limited to the named endpoint and supplied credential condition.

cases.steps:

2. Request the named admin endpoint.
3. Check rejection.
cases.test_data: Fresh follower 1 and follower 2; read-only requests; real-net.
cases.expected: Reject a member session with HTTP 401 or 403.
